Name: EventTester
Author: 91BlaDe
Description:
Tool to assist with the development of Events.
Edit the Event Script in the config file, then press F6 (can be rebound) to start the event in the current Location.

Do note the same can be achieved by reloading specific content patches and using console commands.  This is an alternate, faster way.

There are issues with how the farmer first moves.  This shouldn't affect final movement.

Manifest.Name: EventTester
Manifest.Description: Trigger an event script saved in the config file
